name: AI Presenter
best_for: A face people trust, then the pictures do the talking.
look: A real-looking person opens every video and talks straight to camera, then it cuts to pictures drawn for the exact words being spoken. Built to be cheap: no generated video clips, a fresh picture every ten seconds, and graphics doing the heavy lifting.
tagline: A face people trust, then the pictures do the talking.

devices.use: a new place or time begins: PLACE, a gold rule, the date (over the blurred real picture)
one figure that matters, counting up, its unit, what it means and its source
a comparison with real numbers: 2-6 bars on warm paper, the one that matters highlighted, source under
3-5 dated events on a line the camera travels along
a documented quote, word by word, with who said it and when
one short serif line where the story turns
the question the next part answers
a short card of key lines, the words that matter highlighted
one numbered step of a process
a follow / unfollow between two public accounts
the chapter card: number, kicker, title
a real sentence from a real article with outlet, byline and date
a small table of real figures with its source
where it happens (the template's map colours)
a real photo of a person named, in a pool of light

rules: Every graphic shows a real fact the voice gives at that moment (a name, a date, a place, a figure, a quote) - times come from the word timing, never before the narrator says it.
Footage: clips under 5 s, chained when a line is longer; no talking heads, influencers or logos (QC).

The presenter is the point of this channel, so it is ticked by default — pick the face and the length under Options. Generated video clips are left off: they are the dearest thing in a video and pictures plus graphics carry it for a fraction.

ai_images.scene_prompt:
You are the art director for a faceless YouTube video.

CHANNEL: [INSERT CHANNEL HERE]

Below is the full spoken SCRIPT. Design [INSERT COUNT HERE] distinct background
SCENES that carry this video visually.

RULES
- Each scene illustrates a MOMENT the narrator actually reaches. Read the script
  and follow its order; scene 1 belongs at the start, the last at the end.
- Atmospheric imagery, never text on screen. No words, letters or numbers.
- No faces looking at camera unless the channel is built on a person.
- One subject per scene, described concretely: what is in frame, the light, the
  distance. "A hand resting on a closed book, low window light" — not "wisdom".
- Vary the distance across the set: wide, middle, close. A pool of fifteen
  medium shots edits like a slideshow.

Return ONLY a JSON array of [INSERT COUNT HERE] objects:

  {"text": "<the line of narration this scene belongs to>",
   "prompt": "<a complete image-generation prompt>"}

SCRIPT:
[INSERT SCRIPT HERE]
ai_images.still_suffix: Cinematic still, natural light, shallow depth of field, filmic grain, muted colour, no text, no watermark, no logo.
